content: Beeteliheemeppe Haarizaadey Yaanayssas Imettida Hidota Qaala
Hanne neni ola asata katamaye, ne ola asaa ziirsa. Nuna oykkanaas yuuyi aadhdhida; Isra7eele haarizayssas shagalan guufera shocana.
Hanne ne qasse Beeteliheeme Efraata, Yuhuda zarkketappe neni guuth gidikkoka izas kessay kase beni wodeppe gidida Isra7eele haarizaadey ne giddofe taas kezana.
Hessa gishshas yelizaara miixattada yelana gakkanaas Isra7eeley yegetta attana; hankko attida ishatikka simmidi Isra7eele asara walakettana.
GODAA wolqqan GODAA ba Xoossa sunththa gitateththan minni eqqananne ba mehe izi heemmana; he wode iza wolqqateththay biitta gaxa gakkana gishshas asay giiga duus daana.
Isttas saroteththi iza gidana. GODAY Isra7eele Asaa Ashshananne Istta Morkketa Dhayssana Asoore asay nu biitta worajjishin nu miixataka
menththi gelishin laappun heemmizayta hessafekka osppun halaqata nu iza bolla denththana.
Asoore derey mashshan Namuruude derey koohoppe shodettida giththa mashshan haarettana; Asoore asay nu biitta worajjishininne nu dhas bochchishin izi nuna ashshana.
Yaaqoobe zereththafe attidayti daro dere giddon Xoossa achchafe wodhdhiza ira mala maata bolla loddara puusishe biitta kaaleththiza puuse ira mala asappe aykkoka koyontta asa gidana.

Wora do7ata giddon diza gaammoy, ba tohora icci menththereththishe biza mala, menththereththoyssaka izappe oonikka woththi ekkanaas dandayonttayssa mala; Daro dorsa giddon diza wodalla gaammo mala; Yaaqoobe zereththafe attidayti hankko dereta giddoninne daro asa giddon hessa mala gidana.
Ne kushey ne morkketa xoonidi dhoqqu dhoqqu gaana; ne morkketi wurikka dhayana.
He wode Xoossi, «Ta intte giddofe intte parata dhayssana; para-gaaretakka mulera dhayssana.
Intte biittan diza katamatakka dhayssana; intte miixataka ubbaa laallana.
Intte marotizayssaka dhayssana; hessafe guye marotekketa.
Masetti kezida intte eeqa misletanne intte eeqasohotakka ta intte giddofe dhayssana; hayssafe guye intte intte kushen ooththidaytas goynneketa.
Asheero geetettiza eeqiza misleyo ta intte giddofe shoddana; ta intte katamaakka dhayssana.
Taas azazettontta dereta wolqqama hanqon ta halo kessana» gees.

footnotes.text: Nu miixata gizayssa kase wode birsheththati nu biitta geettes.
